item.title: Takaichi secures sweeping mandate as LDP wins snap election landslide
item.description: ALBAWABA- Japan’s Liberal Democratic Party (LDP), led by Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi, won a decisive landslide in the snap general election, capturing more than 310 of the 465 seats in the House of Representatives.
